description: Centre-to-centre distance between two objects at a date (km and astronomical units) and the light travel time, with the provenance of both positions. Example: from "earth" to "mars".

from.description: First object id from perigee_find (NORAD number, mission id, planet, "moon:<id>", "site:<id>", "launch:<id>", "star:<id>", "comet:<id>", "asteroid:<id>" or a dwarf planet name), e.g. "earth".

to.description: Second object id from perigee_find (NORAD number, mission id, planet, "moon:<id>", "site:<id>", "launch:<id>", "star:<id>", "comet:<id>", "asteroid:<id>" or a dwarf planet name), e.g. "mars".

name: perigee_distance
title: Distance between two objects
